304-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
304-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
304-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tough Cookie.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

512-2872-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

567-1981-2415-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5315-6595--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-6595--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2438-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Carrion Feeder by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3621-4050-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
3621-4050-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

2440-3581-6965-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-6965-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

1183-4045-4853.description:
Activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Ur-Golem's Eye.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

141-3269-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3269-5147.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3269-5147.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

527-1379-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-1379-1978.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

997-1681-4140.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3525-4474-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4681-4894-6542-6798.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1069-3228-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-5499-6633.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Card Preventing Combat Damage Dealt To/By a Creature

5881--101.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
If needed, cast the card preventing combat damage by paying its mana cost or activate it.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking an opponent who controls a creature.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt is prevented due to the damage prevention effect.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.
5881--101.notes: Depending on the card used to prevent combat damage, additional mana and pre-requisites may be required.

372-2493-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2493-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1917-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
1917-4608.description:
Cast Touch the Spirit Realm by paying {2}{W}.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling itself until it leaves the battlefield.
When Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, it returns itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1999-3910-4050.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1651-1999-3910-4050.description:
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Breya from the battlefield to your hand, putting Breya onto the battlefield from your hand.
Breya enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Thopters, untapping Master Transmuter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens and infinite colored mana, you may activate Breya's ability infinite times.

1110-2115-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
The Tree of Perdition copy enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition copy by tapping it, exchanging its toughness with target opponent's life total.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

2651-3311-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Snake Umbra attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
2651-3311-4869.description:
Activate Murderer's Axe's equip ability by discarding a card, targeting any creature.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-2105-5223.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.
